acceptance: Given a requisition inside an approved plan line, when I submit it, then the short approval chain runs (YX-ATS-01).

title: Google for Jobs structured data and careers sitemap

Given the careers site, when the sitemap is requested, then every open job is listed (YX-ATS-45).
Given a closed job, when one day has passed, then it is removed or marked expired (YX-ATS-45).

title: Candidates, talent pools and rediscovery

Given a referral or campus registrant, when saved, then it links to the same person rule (YX-ATS-33).

title: Merge two candidate records with field choice
story: As a recruiter, I want to merge duplicate candidates and choose which values to keep so that each person has one record.
acceptance: Given two candidate records, when I merge them, then I choose each conflicting field value (YX-ATS-03).
Given a merge, when it completes, then both histories (applications, messages, tests) are kept on the result (YX-ATS-03).
Given a merge, when it completes, then an audit entry records who merged what (YX-ATS-03).

title: Candidate portal: confirm parsed fields, upload documents, see status

Given my portal, when I open it, then I see each application status and can upload several documents to the P05 vault (YX-ATS-31).

title: Hotlists, dynamic pools and bench

Given retention is near its end, when the renewal email is sent and not accepted, then the person is anonymised and leaves all pools and sequences (YX-ATS-21).

Given a candidate whose retention or consent has expired, when suggestions are made, then they are not shown (YX-ATS-39).
Given I contact a suggested person, when I send, then nurture-consent rules apply (YX-ATS-39).

title: Sourcing browser extension captures one profile per click

Given a captured profile, when saved, then the source and capture time are recorded (YX-ATS-22).

Given my answers, when I finish, then they land on the same application as the web form with no duplicate candidate (YX-ATS-36).
Given a knockout answer, when it fails, then the recruiter gets a recommendation, not an automatic rejection (YX-ATS-36).

Given a consent, when recorded, then source, time and text version are stored (YX-ATS-20).
Given a WhatsApp step, when sent, then it uses an approved template on the company number (YX-ATS-20).
Given an opt-out, when it is received, then all further steps on that channel stop at once (YX-ATS-20).

Given an under-18 candidate, when the round is set, then the AI interview is not offered (YX-ATS-19).

Given the release date agreed with the current manager, when it is set, then the move is a P06 change effective that date (YX-ATS-13).

Given the unwind, when complete, then the requisition reopens with its pipeline intact (YX-ATS-14).

Given selected candidates, when I issue offers in bulk from one template, then each offer has its own fields (YX-ATS-40).
Given bulk offers, when sent, then each offer runs its own headcount-plan check and its own e-sign envelope (YX-ATS-40).

Given an erase request, when received, then it is completed within the legal limit and logged (YX-ATS-09).

Given an under-18 candidate, when the application is saved, then processing waits for verifiable guardian consent (YX-ATS-19).
Given an under-18 candidate, when screening runs, then no AI interview, AI fit score, semantic ranking or behavioural signals are used (YX-ATS-19).

Given the placement, when saved, then bill rate and pay rate come from the rate card as dated values (YX-ATS-10).
Given a placement, when it starts, then the contractor can log time for that client.

Given OT or holiday hours, when lines are made, then rate-card multipliers apply (YX-ATS-10).
Given the invoice, when issued, then it uses the locked GST tax invoice template (APX-F §3.2, YX-DOC-22).

acceptance: Given a generated bank, accounting or statutory file, when made, then it is a document with a hash (YX-INT-03).
Given a download or release, when done, then it is audited (YX-INT-03).
Given a bank file, when released, then the maker cannot be the checker (YX-INT-03).

title: Slack and Teams apps acting as the linked user
story: As an employee, I want to approve and ask from Slack or Teams so that I do not switch tools.
acceptance: Given a tenant admin consent, when the app is installed, then it works for the tenant (YX-INT-05).
Given a user, when not linked by SSO / OAuth, then the app does nothing for them (YX-INT-05).
Given an action, when taken in chat, then it calls the public API as that user (YX-INT-05).

title: Mailbox sync for matched threads only
story: As a recruiter or agent, I want my email threads linked to records so that the history is in one place.
acceptance: Given my mailbox, when synced, then only threads matched to a candidate, ticket or YukthiX-sent message are imported (YX-INT-06).
Given send-as, when used, then it uses my own OAuth grant (YX-INT-06).
Given I unlink, when done, then sync stops at once; synced content takes the record’s P02 class (YX-INT-06).

title: eKYC and DigiLocker through a licensed partner
story: As a new joiner, I want to share verified documents from DigiLocker so that onboarding is quick.
acceptance: Given eKYC, when used, then it runs only via a licensed partner with explicit per-purpose consent (YX-INT-07).
Given Aadhaar, when used, then the full number is never stored (masked + partner reference) (YX-INT-07).
Given pulled documents, when stored, then they are issuer-verified P05 documents; a non-Aadhaar path always exists (YX-INT-07).

title: Earned wage access partner
story: As an employee, I want early access to earned pay through a partner so that I handle emergencies.
acceptance: Given the company has not enabled it, when I look, then EWA is off (YX-INT-08).
Given EWA on, when I request, then the amount never exceeds earned net pay to date × company cap (YX-INT-08).
Given recovery, when payroll runs, then it is a deduction within the P07 IN.WAGES cap; the partner gets only employee id, limit and bank-verified status (YX-INT-08).

title: Global payroll and EOR connectors
story: As an HR admin with staff abroad, I want to connect a global payroll provider so that all staff are in one system.
acceptance: Given a country without a YukthiX pack, when a provider is connected, then HR data (joiners, leavers, changes, inputs, leave summaries) is pushed (YX-INT-12).
Given provider results, when pulled, then payslips are stored as documents and costs as ledger lines (YX-INT-12).
Given a failure, when it happens, then it shows on Jobs & errors.

title: AI layer and governance
AI feature registry, opt-in and metered calls
story: As an AI governance owner, I want every AI call tied to an approved, registered feature version so that AI use is controlled.
acceptance: Given an AI call, when made, then it runs a registered approved feature version (provider, model, region, prompt hash, data classes) recorded in ai_calls (YX-AI-07).
Given an unregistered model or prompt, when called in production, then it is refused (YX-AI-07).
Given a tenant, when AI features are off, then no call is made; each call is metered in credits and audited (YX-AI-03).
evidence: AiCreditUsage model · apps/api/src/ai/ai-invocation.service.ts — metering and BYO keys exist; registry with versions is new

title: AI guardrails: advice only, data classes and untrusted documents
story: As a DPO, I want AI to advise only and never see Special data so that AI is safe.
acceptance: Given any AI output, when shown, then it is a suggestion a person accepts or edits; AI never approves, rejects or pays (YX-AI-01).
Given Special data, when a prompt is built, then it is never sent; Confidential values are masked unless approved; ID OCR is in-region (YX-AI-02).
Given uploaded documents, when used in prompts, then they are untrusted data and AI tools are read-only governed APIs (YX-AI-05).

title: Providers with no training and region match
story: As a DPO, I want AI providers that do not train on our data and match our region so that contracts are met.
acceptance: Given a provider, when added, then its contract excludes training on customer data (YX-AI-04).
Given a tenant region, when calling, then the provider is consistent with it (YX-AI-04).
Given a provider, when used, then it is on the sub-processor list (APX-G G-04) (YX-AI-04).

title: Eval gate and weekly drift monitoring
story: As an AI governance owner, I want new models to pass evals before going live so that quality does not drop.
acceptance: Given a new model, provider, region or prompt version, when proposed, then it goes live only after its eval set meets thresholds with no regression (YX-AI-08).
Given the result, when reviewed, then a second person signs off (YX-AI-08).
Given live features, when a week passes, then drift metrics are checked with alerts (YX-AI-08).
Given AI quality metrics, when reported, then ai.eval.score, drift, bias impact ratio and human override rate per version come from the metric layer (YX-MET-17).

title: Bias tests and red-team before release
story: As an AI governance owner, I want hiring AI tested for bias and attacks so that it is fair and safe.
acceptance: Given AI interview and candidate-fit, when released and every quarter, then adverse-impact (4/5ths) and score gaps are tested (YX-AI-09).
Given a failing gap, when found, then release is blocked or the feature is disabled (YX-AI-09).
Given red-team and indirect prompt-injection tests (policies, résumés, receipts, chat), when run, then failures block release (YX-AI-09).

title: AI kill switch and incident process
story: As a system admin, I want to switch off any AI feature at once so that we can stop a problem fast.
acceptance: Given any AI feature, when the platform or tenant kill switch is used, then it stops and the non-AI fallback works (YX-AI-10).
Given an AI incident, when raised, then it follows severity, tenant notice and post-mortem (YX-AI-10).
Given personal data involved, when raised, then it links to the P12 incident (YX-AI-10).

title: EU AI Act classification, deployer notice and literacy
story: As an EU tenant admin, I want high-risk AI only after notice to workers so that we meet the EU AI Act.
acceptance: Given an AI feature registry entry, when created, then it states high-risk yes / no / depends and its EU default; without it the feature cannot go live (YX-AI-11).
Given an EU tenant, when enabling a high-risk employment feature, then an admin must record the notice to workers’ representatives and workers as a legal_acceptances row (YX-AI-12).
Given EU candidates or workers, when a yes / depends feature runs, then the EU default applies (YX-AI-11).

title: Face templates for attendance check-in
story: As an employee, I want face check-in only with my consent so that my biometric data is safe.
acceptance: Given face check-in, when enrolling, then explicit consent is required (YX-AI-06).
Given a template, when stored, then it is encrypted in-region and used only for check-in (YX-AI-06).
Given exit or consent withdrawal, when it happens, then the template is deleted (YX-AI-06).

title: Agent action contract for copilots and bots
story: As a security owner, I want agents to act only within the user’s rights so that AI cannot do more than the person.
acceptance: Given an agent, when it runs, then it is a registered feature with a declared agent scope no wider than the person’s P02 rights (YX-AI-13).
Given a write, when prepared, then it is a normal P03 request the person submits (YX-AI-13).
Given the agent, when it reads data, then only allowed data classes are read (YX-AI-13).

title: Copilot channels and fair-use credits
story: As an employee, I want to ask the copilot in Slack, Teams or WhatsApp so that I get answers anywhere.
acceptance: Given Slack / Teams, when used, then YX-INT-05 rules apply (YX-AI-14).
Given WhatsApp, when used, then only my linked verified number works and Confidential values are masked with a deep link (YX-AI-14).
Given the monthly fair-use per user, when exceeded, then AI credits are drawn (YX-AI-14).

title: Plan approval for multi-step agent jobs
story: As a manager, I want to see and approve the agent’s plan first so that nothing unexpected runs.
acceptance: Given a "do this for me" request, when the agent responds, then it shows a plan with records, changes, screens / APIs and irreversible steps flagged (YX-AI-15).
Given the plan, when not approved, then nothing runs (YX-AI-15).
Given execution, when it runs, then it uses public APIs with my own permissions only (YX-AI-15).

title: Metric layer, dashboards and analytics
Metric registry with versions and golden tests
story: As an analyst, I want every number to come from a registered metric so that all screens agree.
acceptance: Given any dashboard, report, export or AI answer, when it shows a number, then it comes from a registered metric or governed record query (YX-MET-01).
Given a metric definition change, when merged, then the version bumps, golden tests run and the changelog updates (YX-MET-02).
Given a standard report, when shipped, then it has its APX-C catalogue row and every measure is registered (YX-MET-13).
evidence: apps/api/src/analytics (item-analytics, pipeline-analytics) — measures exist per module; the registry is new

title: Analytics security and small-group suppression
story: As a DPO, I want analytics to respect scope and hide small groups so that no one is identified.
acceptance: Given any analytics query, when run, then tenant RLS, my P02 scope and field classes apply (YX-MET-03).
Given a Confidential / Special breakdown with a group below the threshold (default 5, range 3–10), when I lack individual access, then it shows "suppressed", also in exports (YX-MET-04).
Given individual access in that scope, when I view, then all groups show (YX-MET-04).

title: Snapshots that rebuild from back-dated changes
story: As an analyst, I want history snapshots corrected by back-dated changes so that trends are right.
acceptance: Given a back-dated change, when saved, then snapshots rebuild incrementally from its effective date (YX-MET-06).
Given total-workforce headcount, when shown anywhere, then it uses workforce.total_persons from snap_person_day (YX-MET-22).
Given a rebuild, when running, then freshness shows on affected widgets.

title: Dashboards with scope and freshness, shared by viewer permissions
story: As a manager, I want dashboards that show their scope and age and only my data so that I trust them.
acceptance: Given a widget or report, when shown, then scope and data freshness are visible; no hidden default entity (YX-MET-05).
Given a shared dashboard, when another person opens it, then it renders with their permissions, never the author’s (YX-MET-07).
Given dashboard templates, when a module ships, then starter dashboards are available to copy.

title: Report builder and calculated metrics
story: As an analyst, I want to build my own reports and formulas so that I answer new questions.
acceptance: Given the metric explorer, when I pick measures and dimensions, then a report is built from governed metrics.
Given a calculated metric, when created, then it is an expression over governed metrics only (YX-MET-11).
Given its inputs, when sensitivity is set, then it inherits the most restrictive one (YX-MET-11).

title: Scheduled deliveries and audited exports
story: As a manager, I want reports emailed on a schedule without leaking data so that I stay informed safely.
acceptance: Given a subscription, when delivered, then it renders with the recipient’s permissions (YX-MET-07).
Given Confidential / Special content, when delivered, then email and WhatsApp carry a secure login link only, no file (YX-MET-08).
Given an export or scheduled delivery, when made, then it is audited (YX-MET-09).
evidence: apps/api/src/scheduled-reports (weekly digest) · apps/api/src/reports/exporters (CSV / XLSX / PDF) — exporters and digest exist; subscriptions are new

title: Standard report library per APX-C
story: As an HR head, I want the standard reports for each module so that I do not build common reports myself.
acceptance: Given each module step, when it ships, then its APX-C reports ship with catalogue rows (YX-MET-13).
Given a report, when run, then as-on or period, format and audience follow the catalogue.
Given the APX-C §2 metric dictionary, when registered, then each metric has a golden test.

title: Ask analytics in plain words
story: As a manager, I want to ask a question in words and get a governed answer so that I do not need a report builder.
acceptance: Given a question, when answered, then only governed metrics through the planner are used; no free-form SQL (YX-MET-10).
Given an answer, when shown, then definitions and filters used are shown (YX-MET-10).
Given a question outside my scope, when asked, then the answer respects my permissions.

title: Anonymous survey results always grouped
story: As an employee answering an anonymous survey, I want no one to see my answers so that I can be honest.
acceptance: Given anonymous survey results, when any viewer opens them (incl. HR / Payroll Admin), then minimum group size applies (YX-MET-12).
Given a team below the minimum, when shown, then it rolls up to its parent group (YX-MET-12).
Given an export, when made, then the same rule applies.

title: Attrition risk scores, confidential and explained
story: As an HR business partner, I want attrition risk with its reasons so that I can act early.
acceptance: Given risk scores, when shown, then only holders of analytics.attrition_risk.view see them (YX-MET-16).
Given a score, when shown, then contributing factors and model version are shown (YX-MET-16).
Given bulk exports or subscriptions, when the recipient lacks the grant, then scores are not included (YX-MET-16).

title: Tenant health feed without personal data
story: As a customer success manager, I want health scores per tenant so that I help customers early, without seeing their people data.
acceptance: Given the platform.tenant_health.* feed, when built, then it carries only counts, rates, scores and object IDs (YX-MET-15).
Given names, HR content or Confidential values, when the feed is built, then they are never included (YX-MET-15).
Given tenant admins, when they look, then they see the same health data (YX-MET-15).

title: Product analytics events and storage
story: As a product manager, I want privacy-safe usage events so that we improve the product.
acceptance: Given product events, when registered in code, then they carry only the allowed properties (key, minute timestamp, product, module, screen, pseudonyms, role, surface, locale, size band) (YX-MET-19).
Given storage, when used, then events live in the separate product_analytics schema, raw events deleted after 13 months, readable only by staff with the role (YX-MET-20).
Given a tenant opts out of non-essential analytics, when events fire, then they are not stored (YX-MET-20).

title: Product metrics: funnel, activation and retention
story: As the founder, I want activation and trial conversion numbers so that I know if the product works.
acceptance: Given product events, when computed, then funnel (sign-up → first value → activated → paid), time to first value per product and activation rate are shown (YX-MET-21).
Given trials, when computed, then trial conversion and cohort retention are shown (YX-MET-21).
Given features, when computed, then adoption and quick-start completion are shown (YX-MET-21).

title: BRSR and Board’s-report disclosure packs
story: As a CFO, I want workforce disclosure packs built from metrics so that statutory reports are accurate.
acceptance: Given a legal entity and financial year, when a pack is built, then only registered esg.*, cases.*, learning.* and workforce metrics are used (YX-MET-23).
Given the pack, when reviewed, then it goes preparer → reviewer → approver with audit (YX-MET-23).
Given breakdowns below entity totals, when shown, then the small-group threshold applies to every viewer; legal totals show in full only to preparers and approvers (YX-MET-24).

title: Partner and accountant console
Partner firm verification and suspension
story: As YukthiX staff, I want partners verified before they reach clients so that only trusted firms get access.
acceptance: Given a partner firm, when identity, tax ids and agreement are not verified, then no client link can be active (YX-PTR-01).
Given a partner is suspended, when it happens, then all its client access stops at once (YX-PTR-01).
Given verification, when done, then it is audited.

title: Tenant ownership and client-approved grants
story: As a client admin, I want to control what my accountant can do so that our data stays ours.
acceptance: Given tenant creation, when done, then ownership (client-owned or partner-owned) is recorded on the link (YX-PTR-02).
Given a client-owned tenant, when a partner needs access, then a client admin approves a grant and can view, change or end it at any time (YX-PTR-02).
Given partner users, when they act, then only assigned users within the grant’s modules, entities and actions can; Special data is never in a grant (YX-PTR-03).

title: Partner actions in the client’s audit log
story: As a client admin, I want to see everything the partner did so that I can trust them.
acceptance: Given a partner action in my tenant, when done, then it is in my audit log with firm and user (YX-PTR-04).
Given "who accessed my data", when an employee opens it, then partner access is included (YX-PTR-04).
Given a filter, when I choose a partner, then only its actions show.

title: Client approval for payroll release and filings
story: As a client finance approver, I want to approve payroll release unless I delegated it so that money moves only with our consent.
acceptance: Given payroll release, bank-file release, statutory filing or DSC signing, when the partner starts it, then a client-side approval is needed (YX-PTR-05).
Given the client delegated that step in the grant, when the partner acts, then no client approval is needed (YX-PTR-05).
Given either case, when the step runs, then step-up MFA applies (YX-PTR-05).

title: Partner login security
story: As a security owner, I want partners to use strong login so that client data is safe.
acceptance: Given a partner user, when logging in, then MFA is required (YX-PTR-06).
Given a partner with 10+ users, when logging in, then SSO or passkeys are required (YX-PTR-06).
Given partner sessions, when idle, then P12 desk session limits apply (YX-PTR-06).

title: Cross-client dashboard with statuses only
story: As an accountant, I want one dashboard across my clients so that I see what is due.
acceptance: Given my clients, when I open the dashboard, then I see statuses, counts and due dates from each client’s status feed (YX-PTR-07).
Given personal data, when the dashboard loads, then none leaves the client tenant (YX-PTR-07).
Given a client row, when clicked, then I enter that client within my grant.

title: Named client contact before live payroll
story: As a client, I want a named contact invited at creation so that someone on our side is accountable.
acceptance: Given a partner-created tenant, when created, then a named client contact must be invited (YX-PTR-08).
Given the contact has not accepted, when live payroll is attempted, then it is blocked (YX-PTR-08).
Given either ownership model, when checked, then the same rule applies (YX-PTR-08).

title: Partner templates copied into clients
story: As an accountant, I want to reuse my templates across clients so that setup is quick and isolated.
acceptance: Given a partner template, when applied, then it is copied into the client (YX-PTR-09).
Given one client edits its copy, when saved, then no other client is affected (YX-PTR-09).
Given the partner updates its template, when saved, then clients are not changed.

title: Reseller hierarchy, billing and commissions
story: As a partner, I want commissions or partner billing per client so that the partnership pays.
acceptance: Given resellers, when set up, then the hierarchy is at most two levels and a master never gets client data through a sub-partner (YX-PTR-10).
Given billing per client, when chosen, then it is direct + referral commission or partner-billed at a discount (YX-PTR-11).
Given prices, when set, then the client price is never above the published price, rates pass YX-BILL-09 and each commission line links to the client invoice (YX-PTR-11).

title: Ending a link and ownership transfer
story: As a client, I want to take full ownership from my partner so that I can change providers.
acceptance: Given a partner-owned → client-owned transfer, when requested, then it completes after the notice period (max 30 days) and the partner cannot block it (YX-PTR-13).
Given open runs, when transferring, then they are completed or handed over and billing moves with ownership (YX-PTR-13).
Given a link ends, when done, then the partner keeps only its own work records; client data, documents and copied templates stay with the client (YX-PTR-12).

title: Partner directory of verified partners
story: As a company, I want to find a verified payroll partner so that we get managed payroll from a trusted firm.
acceptance: Given the directory, when listed, then only verified partners appear (YX-PTR-14).
Given ordering, when computed, then it never depends on payment to YukthiX (YX-PTR-14).
Given YukthiX itself, when asked, then it does not offer payroll or filings as a service (YX-PTR-14).

title: Employee and manager assistants and marketplaces
Payslip explainer from payroll data
story: As an employee, I want to know why my pay changed so that I do not need to raise a ticket.
acceptance: Given two payslips, when compared, then the pay-diff engine names a cause only when a payroll record supports it (YX-AST-04).
Given anything left over, when shown, then it is "not explained" with a Raise payslip query button (YX-AST-04).
Given amounts, when shown, then they come from M03 / P07 engines, never from AI (YX-AST-05).
Given someone else’s payslip, when asked, then it is refused and logged (YX-AST-03).

title: Employee tax planner
story: As an employee, I want to compare tax regimes on my real salary so that I choose well.
acceptance: Given my projected salary and the IN.TDS law version, when I plan, then estimates come from the engine (YX-AST-12).
Given results, when shown, then "Estimate, not tax advice" is shown and no regime is chosen for me (YX-AST-12).
Given my scenarios, when saved, then they are private to me and never in manager views or reports (YX-AST-12).

title: Salary structure optimiser for HR
story: As an HR admin, I want suggested salary splits that pass company and legal rules so that I offer tax-efficient structures safely.
acceptance: Given a suggested split, when shown, then it passes company CTC rules, the 50 % wage rule, minimum wage and PF / ESI (YX-AST-13).
Given HR chooses, when saved, then options shown and the choice are audited (YX-AST-13).
Given a later law change, when published, then saved suggestions are marked stale (YX-AST-13).

title: Payslip and pay questions by AI chat with data tiers
story: As an employee, I want to ask about my pay in my words so that I understand it.
acceptance: Given a P23 AI feature, when registered, then allowed data classes are declared and Special data never goes out (YX-AST-02).
Given salary, bank and PAN values, when prompted, then only placeholders are sent and the app fills them (YX-AST-02).
Given fair use is used up and no credits remain, when I ask, then the rule-based parts still work (YX-AST-17).

title: AI policy and handbook writer

acceptance: Given a draft, when approval is requested, then the P07 law-floor check must have run for every chosen state with findings resolved or acknowledged (YX-AST-06).
Given a draft, when approved, then values enter P19 with impact preview and text enters M08 as a new policy version; never auto-published (YX-AST-06).
Given each clause, when shown, then it is tagged law, company answer or AI suggestion until approval (YX-AST-07).

title: Timesheet auto-fill from work tools
story: As an employee, I want my timesheet pre-filled from my calendar and Jira so that I save time.
acceptance: Given Calendar, Jira or GitHub, when connected, then it is per user by OAuth, read-only and revocable (tokens deleted on revoke or exit) (YX-AST-08).
Given reading, when done, then only metadata (titles, times, keys, repo names) is read; no code or message bodies (YX-AST-08).
Given suggestions, when made, then they fill a draft I submit; raw activity is visible only to me (YX-AST-09).

title: AI manager coach nudges
story: As a manager, I want timely nudges about my team so that I manage better.
acceptance: Given nudges, when made, then they use only signals I can see; never Special data, leave reasons or health (YX-AST-10).
Given attrition risk, when used, then only where I already have that access (YX-AST-10).
Given company frequency, when set, then it applies and I can opt out (YX-AST-10).

title: Review assistant with bias check
story: As a manager, I want my review text checked for bias so that my reviews are fair.
acceptance: Given my draft review, when checked, then bias flags are suggestions and my text and rating are final (YX-AST-11).
Given flag acceptance, when reported, then only in aggregate with small-group suppression (YX-AST-11).
Given an EU tenant, when used, then P10 EU classification and the tenant AI review opt-in apply (YX-AST-11).

title: Group insurance through a licensed partner
story: As a small company owner, I want group health insurance quotes so that I cover my team easily.

Given quotes, when compared, then the same fields are used for every quote and YukthiX gives no advice (YX-AST-14).
Given eligibility, when checked, then only companies at the insurer minimum headcount (default 7) see it; the partner gets census fields only (YX-AST-15).

title: Employee perks marketplace

acceptance: Given perks, when the company has not switched them on, then they are off; the company chooses categories (YX-AST-16).
Given an offer, when shown, then it is labelled "Partner offer" and never appears on payroll, payslip, tax or statutory screens (YX-AST-16).
Given redemption, when done, then only fields I consent to go to the merchant, with consent recorded (YX-AST-16).

title: Company switches, advisory-only rule and audit for helpers
story: As a system admin, I want to switch each helper on or off and audit them so that we control AI use.
acceptance: Given each P23 helper and marketplace, when the company switches it off, then it is hidden (YX-AST-18).
Given any P23 output, when shown, then it is a suggestion; nothing is submitted, published, chosen or bought without the person (YX-AST-01).
Given AI calls, policy approvals, salary choices, insurance purchases and perk redemptions, when done, then they are audited with person, feature version and data classes (YX-AST-19).

title: Workflow Studio and AI assistant
Every automation is a one-step workflow
story: As a system admin, I want my P19 automations to open in Workflow Studio unchanged so that I can grow them later.
acceptance: Given a P19 automation, when opened in Studio, then it is a one-step workflow (YX-WFS-01).
Given conversion, when done, then behaviour is unchanged (YX-WFS-01).
Given a one-step workflow, when edited, then the P19 form stays available (YX-WFS-01).

title: Workflow designer with safe steps, waits and loops
story: As a system admin, I want multi-step workflows with waits and loops so that I automate real processes.
acceptance: Given a create / update step, when it targets governed fields (statutory, locked periods, audit, consent), then it is refused at save and at run (YX-WFS-02).
Given a wait, when saved without a timeout and timeout branch, then save fails (YX-WFS-06).
Given a loop, when saved without a max item count, then save fails (YX-WFS-06).

title: Publish with preview, test run, second approver and versions
story: As a system admin, I want publishing to require a preview and test so that workflows are safe.
acceptance: Given a version, when published, then an impact preview and a test run on sample records are required and stored (YX-WFS-03).
Given a version touching pay, leave balances, access or people data, when published, then a second approver is required (YX-WFS-04).
Given any past version, when needed, then it can be viewed, compared and re-published; runs record their version (YX-WFS-05).

title: Run limits and loop protection
story: As a system admin, I want runaway workflows stopped so that one mistake does not touch thousands of records.
acceptance: Given per-run limits (records, steps, duration), when reached, then the run stops with an alert (YX-WFS-07).
Given tenant daily limits, when at 80 % / 100 %, then alerts go; beyond is the usage add-on, never a silent stop of in-flight runs (YX-WFS-07).
Given a workflow action, when it would re-trigger itself on the same record, then it is stopped; cross-workflow chains stop at a depth limit with a warning (YX-WFS-08).

title: Step failure handling and failure queue
story: As a system admin, I want each step to retry or branch on failure so that problems are handled.
acceptance: Given each step, when saved, then it declares retry, fallback branch or stop-and-alert (YX-WFS-09).
Given a failed run, when it fails, then it appears in the failure queue with step, input and error (YX-WFS-09).
Given the failure queue, when I act, then I can retry or skip with a reason.

title: Undo a workflow run
story: As a system admin, I want to undo a bad run so that mistakes are reversed quickly.
acceptance: Given a run, when undone, then reversible steps are reversed in reverse order using compensating actions (YX-WFS-10).
Given irreversible steps, when undoing, then they are listed and left as they are (YX-WFS-10).
Given a step whose record changed since or whose period is locked, when undoing, then undo is refused and the conflict shown (YX-WFS-10).

title: Outbound HTTP, inbound webhook and email steps
story: As a system admin, I want workflows to call our other systems safely so that processes cross tools.
acceptance: Given an outbound HTTP or connection step, when run, then it calls only admin-approved endpoints or P10 connectors (YX-WFS-11).
Given an inbound webhook, when received, then a valid HMAC signature and timestamp within 5 minutes are required (YX-WFS-11).
Given inbound email, when received, then only allow-listed senders are accepted (YX-WFS-11).

title: Pause one or all workflows
story: As a system admin, I want a kill switch so that I can stop all automation in an emergency.
acceptance: Given one workflow, when paused, then it stops before the next step of every run (YX-WFS-12).
Given the tenant switch, when used, then all workflows pause before their next step (YX-WFS-12).
Given a resume, when done, then paused runs continue.

title: Sandboxed scripts with limited identity and review
story: As a developer admin, I want script steps for special logic so that workflows can do anything safe.
acceptance: Given a script, when run, then it has no file system, no network except approved endpoints, CPU / memory / time limits and a safe SDK subset; inputs, outputs and calls are logged (YX-WFS-13).
Given a script, when it runs, then it uses a service identity no broader than the publisher; secrets come only from the vault; if the publisher’s rights drop, the workflow pauses (YX-WFS-14).
Given publish, when done, then static checks pass, versions are kept and pay or people data needs a second approver (YX-WFS-15).

title: AI build mode drafts workflows but never publishes
story: As a system admin, I want AI to draft a workflow from my words so that I build faster.
acceptance: Given my description, when AI drafts, then it can draft workflows and scripts, explain them and run the impact preview (YX-WFS-16).
Given the AI, when asked to publish, then it cannot; a person with publish rights publishes (YX-WFS-16).
Given the draft, when published, then YX-WFS-03 / 04 / 15 apply.

title: AI do mode with plan approval and always-confirm steps
story: As a manager, I want the assistant to do multi-step tasks after I approve the plan so that work gets done safely.
acceptance: Given a plan, when not approved, then nothing runs; execution uses public APIs with my permissions within the plan; an out-of-plan step stops the run (YX-WFS-17).

Given money, statutory filing, approving others’ requests, candidate rejection, dismissal or pay changes, when reached, then a separate confirmation on the app screen is required per step (YX-WFS-18).
Given such a step, when the AI or a workflow tries it alone, then it is never executed autonomously (YX-WFS-18).

title: Audit and promotion of workflows
story: As an auditor, I want every run and plan step audited so that automation is accountable.
acceptance: Given any run, script call, agent plan or plan step, when done, then who, what, version, identity, records, result and undo are audited (YX-WFS-19).
Given "promotion required", when on, then workflows move from sandbox to production through P15 promotion (YX-WFS-20).
Given a gallery template update, when YukthiX ships it, then tenant workflows are unchanged without acceptance (YX-WFS-20).

title: Global readiness (GCC, EU, Singapore)
Country gate before offering a country
story: As YukthiX staff, I want a country offered only when it is fully ready so that no customer gets a half product.
acceptance: Given a country, when its region is not live or any §5a gate item is not live, then it is not offered at sign-up, new entity or region move (YX-GLB-01).
Given the platform console, when opened, then the gate per country is shown (YX-GLB-01).
Given a staff override, when tried, then it is not possible (YX-GLB-01).

title: No country constants in code
story: As an engineer, I want every country value in P07 packs so that laws change without a release.
acceptance: Given a dated value in P21 (holidays, quotas, rates, deadlines, formats), when used, then it comes from a P07 pack with source, version and maker ≠ checker (YX-GLB-16).
Given a hard-coded country constant, when CI scans P21 code, then it fails (YX-GLB-16).
Given a pack update, when published, then it is versioned.

title: Right-to-left layout from locale
story: As an Arabic-speaking user, I want the app in right-to-left so that it reads naturally.
acceptance: Given my locale is Arabic, when the app loads, then dir="rtl" is set (YX-GLB-02).
Given shared components, when CI lints, then left / right CSS properties fail the build (YX-GLB-02).
Given directional icons, steppers, timelines and charts, when RTL, then they mirror; media controls do not (YX-GLB-02).

title: Display digits and Hijri dates
story: As a GCC user, I want Arabic-Indic digits and Hijri dates if I choose so that dates look familiar.
acceptance: Given stored numbers and dates, when saved, then they are Western digits and Gregorian (YX-GLB-03).
Given my display choice, when on, then Arabic-Indic digits and a Hijri (Umm al-Qura) date beside Gregorian are shown (YX-GLB-03).
Given bank, WPS, GOSI, tax and e-invoice files, when made, then they use the format the receiver requires (YX-GLB-03).

title: Arabic content and bilingual contracts
story: As a GCC employee, I want screens, messages and contracts in Arabic so that I understand them.
acceptance: Given employee screens, notifications and GCC starter templates, when shipped, then they are in Arabic (YX-GLB-04).
Given UAE / KSA contracts and payslips, when issued, then they are bilingual with Arabic marked as prevailing where required (YX-GLB-04).
Given a missing Arabic string, when CI runs, then it fails for GCC templates.

title: Holiday feeds with expected and confirmed dates
story: As an HR admin, I want moving holidays updated automatically so that leave and OT stay right.
acceptance: Given each country pack, when loaded, then it names its holiday feed and each item cites its source (YX-GLB-05).
Given a moving holiday, when published, then it is expected and later confirmed (YX-GLB-05).
Given a confirmed date that differs, when updated, then calendars, leave counts, attendance and holiday OT in open periods are re-computed (YX-GLB-05).

title: Work authorisations and identifiers for filings
story: As an HR admin, I want visa and permit expiries tracked so that no one works without a valid permit.
acceptance: Given a person, when added, then several authorisations with type, expiry and sponsor entity can be held (YX-GLB-06).
Given reminders at 90 / 60 / 30 / 7 days, when due, then a renewal task opens; an expired or missing authorisation flags payroll pre-flight (YX-GLB-06).
Given WPS (SIF, Mudad), GOSI and pack filings, when made, then identifiers come from work_authorisations / employee_identifiers; a missing one fails pre-flight with a Fix link (YX-GLB-07).

title: Country bank validation and payment file formats
story: As a payroll admin, I want bank details validated per country and the right payment file so that pay is not rejected.
acceptance: Given account details, when saved, then IBAN, BIC, ABA, sort code or IFSC are validated by country (YX-GLB-08).
Given a pack, when payment files are made, then SEPA pain.001, NACHA, BACS or the pack format is produced by M03 exporters (YX-GLB-08).
Given an invalid detail, when saving, then a clear error is shown.

title: Multi-currency payout and split pay
story: As an employee, I want my pay split across accounts and currencies so that I manage my money.
acceptance: Given pay, when computed, then it is in the employment pay currency (YX-GLB-09).
Given payout in another currency, when made, then a dated rate from a named source is used and stored with the payslip (YX-GLB-09).
Given split pay, when set, then at most 3 accounts: fixed amounts first, then %, remainder to primary (YX-GLB-09).

title: Data residency and multi-region tenants
story: As a GCC customer, I want our data kept in-country so that we meet residency law.
acceptance: Given a legal entity, when its people data is stored, then it lives in its data region; UAE / KSA data, files, backups and DR stay in-country (YX-GLB-10).
Given a multi-region tenant, when set up, then control data has one home region (YX-GLB-10).
Given a cross-region screen, when opened, then it queries each entity’s region at read time (YX-GLB-10).

title: Region move with verification
story: As a system admin, I want to move our data to another region safely so that we can meet new rules.
acceptance: Given a move, when requested by a System Admin and approved by YukthiX, then it runs outside the payroll-critical window with a freeze of at most 24 hours (YX-GLB-11).
Given the copy, when done, then checksums and row counts verify it before cut-over (YX-GLB-11).
Given cut-over, when complete, then source data is deleted (YX-GLB-11).

title: Country e-invoicing for YukthiX and staffing invoices
story: As a finance user in KSA, UAE or the EU, I want invoices in the national scheme so that they are legal.
acceptance: Given KSA, when an invoice is made, then ZATCA Fatoora clearance / reporting, QR and stamp apply (YX-GLB-12).
Given UAE or an EU country, when an invoice is made, then the pack scheme applies (YX-GLB-12).
Given scheme rules, when they change, then they are dated pack data (YX-GLB-12).

title: Emiratisation and Nitaqat tracking
story: As a GCC HR admin, I want our nationalisation band tracked so that we meet quotas.
acceptance: Given each GCC entity, when the month closes, then a snapshot of nationals / non-nationals, band, target and gap is made (YX-GLB-13).
Given a planned exit or hire, when it would breach the target, then a warning is shown (YX-GLB-13).
Given rules, when used, then they come from AE.EMIRATISATION / SA.NITAQAT P07 data (YX-GLB-13).

title: Singapore pack: CPF, SDL, IR8A, KETs and flexible-work requests
story: As a Singapore HR admin, I want local payroll and MOM rules so that we comply.
acceptance: Given SG.* packs, when payroll runs, then CPF age bands and ceilings, SDL and IR8A / AIS come from them (YX-GLB-14).
Given Key Employment Terms and payslips, when issued, then MOM content and timing apply (YX-GLB-14).
Given a flexible-work request, when submitted, then it is a P03 request with the response deadline and written-reason rule (YX-GLB-14).

title: EU whistleblower timings
story: As an ethics officer in an EU entity, I want the legal clocks applied so that we answer reporters on time.
acceptance: Given an EU entity with 50+ workers, when a whistleblower case opens, then acknowledgement is due within 7 days (YX-GLB-15).
Given acknowledgement, when done, then feedback is due within 3 months (YX-GLB-15).
Given records, when kept, then only as long as the pack allows (YX-GLB-15).

title: Legal artefacts and notices
Public legal pages with versioned acceptance
story: As a customer, I want clear terms, DPA, privacy, SLA and trust pages so that I can sign up with confidence.
acceptance: Given G-01–G-05, G-15–G-18, G-21–G-23, when published, then each page has a version and date.
Given sign-up or a new version, when the admin accepts, then a legal_acceptances row records who, what version and when.
Given security.txt, when requested, then it is served at /.well-known/security.txt (G-22).

title: Sub-processor list with change notice
story: As a customer DPO, I want notice before a new sub-processor so that I can object.
acceptance: Given the sub-processor page (G-04), when opened, then all sub-processors incl. AI providers are listed.
Given a new sub-processor, when planned, then subscribed customers are notified before the change date.
Given an objection, when received, then it is recorded.

title: Notice templates for employees, candidates and external users
story: As an HR admin, I want ready notices for employees, candidates and external logins so that we inform people correctly.
acceptance: Given G-06, G-07 and G-09, when a product is switched on, then the notices are applied as starter templates.
Given the AI-use disclosure (G-11), proctoring notice (G-12) and retention page (G-13), when published, then they match the live settings.
Given the e-sign consent (G-19), WhatsApp / SMS opt-in text (G-20) and EWA terms (G-24), when shown, then the exact text version is recorded with consent.

title: Jurisdiction-aware biometric consent texts
story: As a candidate, I want biometric consent in words that match my law so that I know my rights.
acceptance: Given G-08, when a candidate is in India, EU or Illinois, then the DPDP, GDPR Art. 9 or BIPA text is shown.
Given consent, when recorded, then the text version and jurisdiction are stored (YX-EVAL-09).
Given a new text version, when published, then new consents use it.
